**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve sanitized JSON for JSONB inserts**

When `PmTimeseriesRepo` sanitizes `JSON.stringify(rawPayload)` before inserting into `raw_payload JSONB`, these key/value regexes can match inside JSON object keys (for example `{"client_secret":"abcdefghijklmnop"}`) and replace `client_secret":"..."` with an unquoted redaction marker, producing invalid JSON. Any webhook payload containing a long `client_secret` or `api_key` field will make `recordEvent`/`recordSnapshot` fail at the JSONB insert instead of being queued into the timeseries tables.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude PM events without a scoped project**

In the GitHub webhook path, normal `issues`/`pull_request` rows usually have `project_id = null` because `normalizePmWebhookEvent` only derives it from project/projects-v2 fields; this branch then treats those rows as visible to every persona. A manager or investor querying `/api/data/timeseries` will therefore get opened/closed counts from repositories outside their permitted project scope, so unknown projects should be mapped to an internal project or excluded rather than allowed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Count only non-null status transitions**

Rows loaded by `timeseriesHandler` always set `fromStatus` and `toStatus` to the database values, which are `null` for ordinary issue/PR events. Since `null !== undefined`, every scoped event is counted as a status transition, so `totals.statusTransitions` is inflated by all opened/closed events unless the row omitted these properties entirely; check for a non-null status value or an actual status change instead.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Deduplicate snapshots before computing burndown**

The reconcile task stores a new snapshot on every run (default every 6 hours), but this aggregation counts every open snapshot row in the bucket. With one open item, the daily bucket reports up to 4 remaining items and a monthly bucket can report roughly 120, so burndown is driven by polling frequency rather than current remaining work; aggregate the latest snapshot per `sourceType/sourceId` within the bucket instead.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Defer Teams profile rejection until a command is found**

This lookup and null-profile rejection runs before checking `trimmed.startsWith("/")` or recognizing a free-text executable intent. In a registered project channel, any normal conversation from an unmapped or aad-less user now gets a “cannot execute command” reply instead of just being stored, which will spam discussion channels; only reject after a slash command or recognized executable free-text intent actually needs authorization.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Honor chat-requested manager summary periods**

When the chat tool sends `showManagerSummary({ periodDays: 7 | 14 | 28 })`, `loadView` always passes the current `PeriodSelection` (initially the calendar month), so this branch runs and the documented `periodDays` parameter is ignored. Chat-triggered manager summaries now fetch the selected calendar period instead of the requested 7/14/28-day window; only pass `selection` for period-control updates or otherwise merge it without discarding `periodDays`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
